Procedure:
Introduction

This 
 document outlines the major maintenance procedures check listed P1, which must 
 be performed every three years as indicated by Y3 in the above title block.
This sight glass is used to show the drum level.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Abd El-Maksoud, 
 reviewed by director eng. Gamal Arafa and revised by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil; EDEPC quality control 
 general director, accepted by eng. Mahmoud El 
 Nakieb general director and approved by eng. Tarek Youssef Head Sector of Ayoun Moussa Power Station 2x320MW.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & 
 inspection and quality control general director, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC Admin. & financial inspection, quality 
 control general director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head 
 sector.

Technical Specification of drum level 
 sight glass
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must 
 be issued and the qualified stuff should be carry the suitable safety category 
 .

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as helmet , 
 shoes , .. etc.
Close the isolating valves for water and steam of this drum level sight glass.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller,
Torque wrench

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Isolation
Notify "Operations" that the gauge is being taken out of service.

It is not necessary to remove the gauge from its flanged mounting for normal 
port maintenance. However, for convenience it may be removed, if allowed by 
plant guidelines, and taken to the shop area by using the steam and water valves 
to isolate from drum pressure.

Remove the gauge from drum service and depressurize by alternately closing the 
upper and lower gauge valves tightly, opening the drain valve and drain 
the water from the gauge. For temperature equalizer gauge installations. *the 
downcomer valve must be closed.

sections.text: Warning:

The drain valve must always remain open while it out of service for any reason. 
The ideal drain line should exhaust to an accumulator or collector tank which is 
vented to atmosphere.

Exhausting to a pressurized tank could result in a back pressure on the gauge 
and present a hazardous condition to personnel when performing maintenance on 
the equipment.
Disassembly

Remove the cover plate(s), glass, packing strip, and cushion gasket (as an 
assembly) from the centerplate.
Remove the mica set, sealing gasket.

sections.text: Inspection / Cleaning

items:
Careful examination of each cover plate is required in order to determine its 
 physical condition.

The top or flat portion of the cover plate 
 ring is the mica bearing surface and must, 
 therefore, be free from radial scratch marks or other imperfections 
 that may cause leakage. This surface must be flat and smooth. To assure 
 flatness of this surface, it should be lapped 
 on a flat plate using 600 grit paper.

The surface in the bottom of the glass pocket where the glass cushion gasket 
 rests must be flat, smooth, and free of previous gasket residue. This 
 surface may be cleaned with a soft wire brush.

At the front side of the cover plate, the four counter bored cap screw seats
 are to be free of rust, dirt and thread lubricant residue. These 
 may be cleaned with a wire brush.

sections.text:
Removal of the used mica and gasket reveals port bottom (gasket seating 
 surface), clearly indicates that it requires the removal of gasket material 
 deposits and any other imperfection that would affect proper gasket sealing.

A port refinishing tool shall be used to 
 clean and polish the port bottom in order to obtain a totally flat surface 
 with the correct finish. This tool is available from Diamond Power Specialty 
 Company as part number 108586-2033.

By using this tool and a variable speed drill for 
 polishing, the correct sealing surface can be attained.

sections.text: Finishing Tool Assembly

The finished 
 port seal surface must be flat, clean and free of all scratches and 
 irregularities. The surface shall approximate a 32 finish. Maximum pocket 
 depth must not exceed .536"
Proper finish
Assembly

Preassemble the cover plate by first 
installing the cushion gasket in the bottom of the glass pocket. Then install 
new glass.

Now that the port bottom is polished and cleaned and the tapped holes
rechased, assembly of the port can begin. The sealing 
gasket is installed first in the center plate pocket, then the mica.set. All 
pieces of mica supplied in the kk must be used.

Installation of the mica sets is very important. Be sure to put the mica piece, 
with the water soluble dot, towards the steam/water side (thickest of the
multi piece mica set). The thickest piece can 
better accommodate gasket loads
and, therefore, promote longer mica life. Be sure to handle the mica with clean 
hands to lengthen the life of these parts and promote good visibility. Keep the 
mica clean from lubricants, finger prints, and moisture.

Next, place the previously
assembled cover plate assembly over these components in the pocket. these components 
in the pocket

Install bolts finger tight while holding the cover plate flat against
the gasket. This will assure that
the cover plate starts straight.

Cover plate torquing is accomplished 
 using the pattern shown. Torque to 25 ft-lbs in 5 ft-lb increments. The 
 alternate criss-cross pattern will provide an equal distribution of load on 
 the sealing gasket. Multiple passes with the torque wrench at final torque 
 (25 ft-lbs) is required to ensure an equal gasket deflection. Observe the 
 socket during the final torquing and continue the pattern passes until
 no movement of the socket occurs.

NOTE: Under no circumstances should the 
 cover plate bolts be torqued higher than 25 ft-lbs
